hidden.why: Identity of the reporter; a report must not reveal which enrolled staff member filed it.
Department of the reporter. In a 5-department company with small teams this narrows the reporter to a handful of people.

mayReveal.why: The roster of enrolled keys is public (who may report is not secret, who did report is).
Hash of the encrypted report body; needed so the officer can match the off-chain ciphertext.

mayReveal.fact: staffKey(staffSecret) is enrolled and has not reported in the current month
mayReveal.why: Membership and rate limit are the contract's purpose. Only a month-scoped nullifier with 256-bit secret input is disclosed.
Only the Merkle root, already public.

acceptedLeakage: The number of reports per month.
Submission time and the transaction fee payer are outside the contract (reporters should use a fresh/unlinked wallet).
The size of the enrolled roster (the anonymity set).

unlinkable.why: A report must not be attributable to an enrolled key.
Reports by the same person in different months must not be linkable.
